review.rationale: The Decision correctly authorizes a new governance cycle rather than retrying the consumed original run. It preserves the original failure evidence and explicitly forbids retrying the original validation. It removes all remote-tracking-ref dependence by requiring local immutable commit object checks and ancestry verification without any remote fetch or refspec changes. It binds immutable local full commit objects (result: 7a20c77, recommendation: 7936b8d, decision: 4a4d61a) with strict ancestry requirements. It permits exactly five canonical paths and one offline replacement validation with zero network requests. It allows one commit/push only on complete PASS with a fail-closed gate. It preserves all commercial, certification, standard, production, authority, and ownership nonclaims as false. All boundary conditions are satisfied with no blockers or corrections needed.
